methods.title: Session-local caller mapping correction
methods.failure_signature: Planning caller row crosses the x1-before-x2 lifecycle boundary
trigger_preconditions: Frozen caller fixture assigns one x2 operation to an x1-labelled caller
methods.candidate_workaround: Create additive session-local x1 and x2 pairs without rewriting planning.
methods.recurrence_guard: Validate every caller pair against its lifecycle stage before execution.
methods.rollback: Retain frozen planning and remove only the additive mapping if smoke evidence fails.
